findings.text: the OSError/EvidenceSynthesisError fallback that serves the record's own bytes is not exercised by any test, so a regression there would answer a 500 or the raw record with nothing reddening.
the audit fallback to _plan_html._read_plan_text is untested on the same terms, so the audit would silently report on the record alone if the composer started raising.
the docs/evidence/<plan>-landed.html spelling that _evidence_record_plan resolves (and serve.py:2036 duplicates) is never written by either test file, so only the archive spelling is covered.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit; 32d932b2 carries the two readers and the three-case test, and 53ceb356 carries only the plan section, the evidence anchor and readers.svg, so no production path outside the two readers named in the goal is changed.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_readers_compose_the_record.py and its three cases; the manifest records 34 passed EXIT=0 in logs/gate-green.log, and an independent re-run of that one file at the pinned head 53ceb356 in a scratch tree passed 3/3 (logs/review-rerun-head-53ceb356.log).
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to route the served evidence record and the audit-doc through compose_landed_record; reckon/serve.py:2113 calls the composer from the record branch of Handler.do_GET, and reckon/doccheck.py:1243 calls it from _composed_record_text, which line 1253 routes every record path through, so both readers the goal names read the composed bytes.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the gate command and its result, names both gate logs and the negative-control log, and its negative_control_note matches the log it names, where the served-bytes case is red while the audit and no-fragment cases stay green.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's six declared paths; the diff 8ab4d4b8..53ceb356 touches exactly those six and nothing else, with 353 insertions and one replaced line.

justifications.durability: the served-bytes case is falsified by the declared negative control and the ETag, 304 and composed-audit branches redden on reversion, but both readers' fallback branches and the second record spelling have no test.
justifications.evidence: the manifest's 34-passed gate result is reproduced by an independent 3/3 run of the named test at the pinned head, recorded in logs/review-rerun-head-53ceb356.log.
justifications.fit: the ETag and no-cache handling in reckon/serve.py:2101 mirrors _send_file at reckon/serve.py:2052, though _evidence_record_plan is duplicated verbatim at reckon/serve.py:2036 and reckon/doccheck.py:1211.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/serve.py:2113 and reckon/doccheck.py:1243 both pass a record path to compose_landed_record, which is the routing the goal states.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat over 32d932b2 and 53ceb356 lists only the six declared paths, and no plan-version or plan-modified meta line is touched.
